sources.title: qwen2.5:0.5b - ollama.com
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 models are pretrained on Alibaba's latest large-scale dataset, encompassing up to 18 trillion tokens. The model supports up to 128K tokens and has multilingual support.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 - a Qwen Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Qwen2.5 language models, including pretrained and instruction-tuned models of 7 sizes, including 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, 7B, 14B, 32B, and 72B.

sources.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs
sources.snippet: Here is a model card detailing the key parameters of the Qwen2.5 LLM models. This release includes seven open-sourced models with sizes ranging from 0.5B to 72B. Most models support a context length of 128K (131,072) tokens and can generate up to 8K tokens, enabling the production of extensive text outputs. sources.title: Function Calling and Tool Use | QwenLM/Qwen2.5 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page explains how to use Qwen2.5's function calling and tool use capabilities, which allow the model to interact with external functions and tools. These capabilities enable Qwen2.5 to extend beyond text generation to perform actions like retrieving real-time information or executing calculations.
